New in this build:
- RECORD on the pad faceplate (top right, next to the piano-roll button) and REC on the sequencer: a 1- or 2-bar metronome count-in (the count shows on the button), then the pattern plays and every pad you hit lands in it on that pad's own channel. Tap again to stop recording. Count-in length and metronome are in the menu.
- Each pad is its own MIDI channel. A pitched hit goes out as a pitched note, so a DAW piano roll has full control of pitch and velocity; played back into BreakBoss it plays that pad at that pitch and records it. The cloud exports a 12-track MIDI file (one track per channel).
- The sequencer wears the faceplate's finish: platinum / black for MODERN, cream for VINTAGE, blue for TEXTURE. Notes and the selected track light in the same colour.
- MAIN A is gone. BPM slider goes to 280 with + / -. SWING and HUMANIZE open sliders when tapped; the knobs have a bigger grip and turn instead of scrolling the rack.
- Tap a track header to select it. The arrow opens that track's piano roll with KEY / SCALE / SNAP / FIT buttons. The velocity / pitch lane edits the open track only.
- The grid opens blank with every other beat darker; a pressed step lights its inner slot. Every button is a real control that presses in.
Please try: RECORD from the pads with a count-in, then open the sequencer and look at each pad's piano roll; the finish in each mode; the swing and humanize sliders.
